    "owner": "Not specified in input",
    "participants": [
      "The owner",
      "Teachers and teaching assistants",
      "Customers' school offices"
    ]
  },
  "inputs_data_required": [
    "The teacher's or TA's list of items",
    "The school's name written on the printed receipt",
    "Docket book pages stapled together"

    "A teacher or TA arrives with a list of items ordered by the school",
    "The shop makes it up from memory",

    "At some point someone types the invoice and emails it to the school office",
    "Some schools require a purchase order number on the invoice which cannot be provided without asking"

    "Issue receipts separately from the docket book, with the school's name on both",
    "Ask the school to confirm its purchase order number during the transaction",
    "Generate the invoice automatically from the sales record using the purchase order number",
    "Send the invoice electronically immediately after the sale, showing the correct due date",
    "Report monthly on outstanding balances per school"

    "Stocktake records older than three weeks are destroyed"
  ]
}
